`raw Qt total` is the number to read. It already excludes the paths `core-rs/src/actions.rs`
claims (read from that file at scan time, not typed here), SwiftUI symbol names, and the core's
own `view.*`. 26 of the 103 below are interpolated TEMPLATES: each expands to an unknown
number of runtime paths and needs a parameterised view, not a substitution.

An earlier version of this file said 84, from a regex written by hand in the same session that
already owned this tool -- a re-derivation of a measurement I had, and wrong in both directions:
it missed the paths passed as constants and counted the ones the core already claims. The tool
resolves constants and reads the claimed list from the core's source. Two of its own predicates
were wrong when this ran: `view.operatorControl` was listed as hub-gated (it is computed by
`operatorcontrol::operator_control_view` reading the Qt backend, not by a `hub::` function), and
`"camera.fill"` counted as a path after a symbol name moved into a model constant named
`idleMark`. Both fixed in the same commit as this file.

Status: `passthrough` = still Qt, nothing asked for yet; `requested <date>` = one-line request
sent to the Rust session; `-> view.x` = converted. **The count going down is the progress report,
but what each path BECAME is the deliverable.**
